name: Perfume ~Saimin Kousui~
source:
College science professor Shichio Imai has perfected a scent with far-reaching effects. 
It titillates the senses of a specific partner, evoking a profound deep pleasure. 
Made from lady waters and essences and pheromones, it achieves technical brilliance with effortless grace. 
He calls it the Breath of Amadeus. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE121244.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
大学理科教授希奇奥·伊迈研制出一种具有广泛效果的香气。
它能挑逗特定对象的感官，唤起深沉而强烈的快感。
以女性体液、精华与信息素调制而成，轻描淡写间便展现出精妙的技术。
他将它命名为「阿玛迪乌斯之息」。

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE121244.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
